nhlCalibration.method: Frozen pregame forecasts; first player/game/threshold per source and calibration version; final results only; separate model-target and observed-Sleeper cohorts; scores balanced by player-game then game.
nhlCalibration.limitation: Descriptive results do not prove calibration or profitability, do not alter frozen probabilities, and do not enable live offers.

lineValidation.method: Frozen fresh observed Sleeper thresholds; separate source/calibration versions; later whole-game holdout; exact thresholds must beat training-only references on Brier and log loss and pass calibration bias. NBA/NHL results are review evidence only and never auto-enable platform offers.

NBA.coverage: Active roster candidates; regular-season games within 48 hours

NHL.coverage: Top eight current shooters per team; regular-season games within 48 hours

validation.method: Frozen pregame probabilities; versions separated; later whole-game holdout; scores balanced by player-game then event; exact targets reviewed separately.
validation.limitation: Model-target accuracy is not platform wager win rate. Reviewable support is not proof of calibration, betting edge, or generalization. Reports never enable baseline offers.
